newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek says merger strengthens operations.
newsitem.headline: Partek says merger strengthens operations.

text.p: The merger between Finnish cargo handling group Partek Oy Ab and state-owned vehicles group Sisu Oy will strengthen the operations of both groups, Partek president and CEO Christoffer Taxell said on Wednesday.

"I am convinced that the merger between Partek and Sisu is the right move, one that will strengthen the activities of both companies. It will create added value for the shareholders as well," Taxell said in a company statement.
"(It) will lead to an internationally competitive company which will have a strong position in all its business areas," Taxell said.
"The actions we publish today are a continuation of those changes Partek has undergone during the 1990s," he said.
Taxell said the company would continue to focus on its engineering business.
"We (will) focus strongly on our engineering industry, which at present (cargo handling equipment unit) Cargotec represents," Taxell said.
Partek would also preserve its profitable mineral-based activities, which, Taxell said, "have developed well during the last years and which continue to represent future growth potential".
"Through the arrangement, a new Finnish company is being created which is also internationally signficant," Partek quoted Minister of Trade Antti Kalliomaki as saying.
Partek said any immediate staff effects would only concern group administration.
